summary: Reference implementation of the KwikBucks correlation-clustering algorithm, which combines cheap-weak similarity signals with a limited budget of expensive-strong queries (e.g. a cross-encoder) to cluster at scale. Meridian is applying it to record deduplication in the data platform.
